method: ARM/Thumb recursive control flow with ARM7 guards; whole-ROM aligned pointers, Thumb/ARM weak signatures; separate rooted census and estimated extents
limitations: Control-flow bounded means decoded paths terminate or loop; it does not prove compiler ownership, stack balance or runtime reachability.
Static discovery is not proof of function boundaries or reachability.
Indirect jumps and jump tables can hide code; unresolved bytes may include code, pools, data and padding.
Tiles include estimated envelopes and local literals; copied RAM code is counted once at ROM load offsets.
Self-modifying audio paths are decoded from the original image only.

code_census.basis: Pre-weak strong snapshots; physical aliases counted once.
code_census.confidence: Static roots; boundaries, open targets and gaps remain qualified.

strong_rooted_instruction.evidence_basis: ARM/Thumb CFG observation from corroborated roots; not runtime or function ownership.

source_authored_unrooted_instruction.evidence_basis: Explicit matching assembly instruction and fixed native encoding; no execution root or runtime claim.

instruction_and_referenced_data_dual_use.evidence_basis: Qualified instruction and data-reference observations with reviewed dual-use evidence.

strong_rooted_referenced_data.evidence_basis: Strong-rooted literal/table references; role does not prove bytes can never execute.

known_data.evidence_basis: Independently supplied data region or explicit data-only source/glue extent.

owned_extent_unclassified.evidence_basis: Independent source/glue extent, without a qualified instruction or data role here.

estimated_envelope_unclassified.evidence_basis: Provisional discovery envelope only; neither byte role nor function boundary is established.

unresolved.evidence_basis: No supplied strong instruction/data observation or owned/estimated extent.

ambiguous_mode_conflict.evidence_basis: ARM and Thumb rooted or source-authored instruction roles overlap; no mode is selected as confirmed.

ambiguous_instruction_known_data.evidence_basis: Rooted or source-authored instruction overlaps an independently supplied data role.

ambiguous_instruction_data_overlap.evidence_basis: Rooted or source-authored instruction and referenced-data roles overlap without reviewed dual-use evidence.

contingent_unqualified_observation.evidence_basis: Raw CFG instruction observation excluded by reviewed context-specific evidence; alternative retained.

limitations: CFG unions do not prove function ownership or runtime reachability; table prefixes may be incomplete.
Owned extents include pools/alignment. Weak seeds, linked-only tags and copies cannot establish code.
Source-authored instruction roles establish static assembly provenance only; they add no CFG observations or entries.
Unresolved bytes may contain code; no whole-code denominator is inferred.

quality_annotations.reason: Presumed return from main reaches a Thumb branch into independently established ARM startup, then scheduler literals. Exclude only descendants in this startup context; independently rooted scheduler instructions remain.
evidence: ARM startup at 0x080000C0 is established by reset control flow and mode exchange.
Thumb startup at 0x080000EC calls main via MOV LR,PC / BX R1; following branch does not exchange mode.
The main CFG has no normal return, but fallback branch and raw alternative reach remain recorded; no universal nonlocal-control claim.

quality_annotations.reason: Original ARM return word is also read as data for the known one-time IRQ patch. Count physical bytes once and preserve both roles.
evidence: Original IRQ CFG reaches this ARM return.
PC-relative load at execution 0x0300006C reads execution 0x03000078; store at 0x03000074 uses it at 0x0300004C.
No patched runtime instruction state was observed.
